definitions.install_proxy_posthog: Distinct persons with event Application Installed (not store units).
definitions.reviews_store: From Play/App Store APIs in store section (sample/pagination limits apply).
definitions.reviews_in_app: PostHog review_prompt_requested / write_review_tapped (not published star count).
definitions.paid_posthog: paywall_purchase_success and paywall_purchase_result in PostHog; use Store/RevenueCat for ledger truth.
definitions.crashes: Crashlytics via BigQuery export; PostHog $exception also listed if captured.
definitions.uninstalls: Not available on iOS; Android uninstall metrics require Play reporting APIs (not in this script yet).

posthog.audience_sql:
(
  lower(coalesce(properties.build_type, 'release')) != 'debug'
  AND lower(coalesce(properties.runtime_target, 'device')) NOT IN ('simulator', 'emulator')
  AND coalesce(toString(properties.is_internal), 'false') != 'true'
)
